/* ============================================================
   AREAS OF FOCUS
   ============================================================ */

.focus {
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto 4rem auto;
}

.focus-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1.25rem;
}

.focus-card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 210px;
  padding: 2rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e1e5e9;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(32, 37, 43, 0.05);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.focus-card::before {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 2rem;
  width: 2.5rem;
  height: 4px;
  content: "";
  background: #7a2e1d;
  border-radius: 0 0 999px 999px;
}

.focus-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(32, 37, 43, 0.09);
}

.focus-number {
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  color: #7a2e1d;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}

.focus-card h3 {
  margin: 0 0 0.8rem 0;
  color: #20252b;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.focus-card p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #667085;
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.focus-link {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 1.4rem;

  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

}

EL PASO CRIME LAB
:::

# Advancing the Science of <span class="accent">Public Safety.</span>

::: {.hero-intro}
The El Paso Crime Lab is an independent initiative connecting research, data, and professional experience to improve our understanding of crime and public safety. Rooted in El Paso and the Borderland, our work aims to make public safety knowledge accessible to everyone.
:::

:::

## Four journals. One shared purpose.

Good ideas and lessons from the field deserve to be shared. EPCL Publications provides a space for researchers, practitioners, and other contributors to share knowledge that can inform public safety practice.
